title: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce with polenta
steps: Knead the mince with the egg, Parmesan, oats, 1 garlic clove, parsley, salt and pepper and shape into 14 balls.
Brown the meatballs all over in the oil for 5 minutes.
Chop the onion and remaining garlic, sweat briefly, add the passata and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Bring the stock to the boil, stir in the polenta and let it thicken for 10 minutes, stirring.
Spoon the meatballs and sauce over the polenta and sprinkle with basil.
